summary:
Added HDR 10-bit color mode, supporting 10-bit high dynamic range video capture. Play back footage on a device that supports high dynamic range display for the best viewing experience.
Added support for HDR Enhancement in Photo mode. Play back footage on a device that supports high dynamic range display for the best viewing experience.
Added a D-Log 10-bit color mode for slow motion.
Added joystick support for 45° diagonal gimbal movement.
Optimized the interaction experience and image quality in certain scenarios.
Fixed some known issues.
